'''''The Imperial Military Guide to Correct Thought''''' was a document used by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] that cultivated pro-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] thought among personnel and described the punishments needed in situations of disobedience of these restrictions.

*''[[Star Wars: Force Commander]]'' {{C|Game manual}}
